topics.title: Technical SEO: Crawling, Indexing and Rendering
topics.description: How search engines discover, crawl, render and index URLs, and how to remove crawl waste, duplicates and index bloat.
topics.whenToUse: Use when a page is not indexed or indexed wrongly, when crawl stats look wasteful, when planning robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, noindex or JavaScript rendering fixes, or when auditing index coverage after a release.

topics.title: Site Architecture and Internal Linking
topics.description: Information architecture, crawl depth, internal link equity flow, hub pages, breadcrumbs and orphan pages.
topics.whenToUse: Use when planning site structure, fixing orphan pages, distributing authority with internal links, deciding on pagination or breadcrumbs, or restructuring a category tree.

topics.title: Core Web Vitals and Page Experience
topics.description: LCP, INP and CLS work, page speed diagnostics, image and font delivery, render-blocking resources and performance budgets.
topics.whenToUse: Use when diagnosing Core Web Vitals failures in Search Console or CrUX, improving LCP or INP, reducing layout shift, or setting performance budgets for a release.

topics.title: Structured Data and Rich Results
topics.description: Schema.org markup, JSON-LD implementation, rich result eligibility, validation and deprecated markup.
topics.whenToUse: Use when adding or debugging schema.org markup, chasing rich result eligibility, handling markup deprecations, or validating JSON-LD before shipping templates.

topics.title: On-Page SEO and Content Optimization
topics.description: Titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, keyword placement, E-E-A-T signals and page-level content quality.
topics.whenToUse: Use when optimizing an existing page, rewriting titles and meta descriptions, fixing thin or duplicated pages, or improving E-E-A-T signals on money pages.

topics.title: Content Strategy and Topical Authority
topics.description: Content clusters, editorial planning, content audits and refreshes, decay, and building topical depth.
topics.whenToUse: Use when building a content plan, deciding what to refresh or prune, mapping clusters and pillars, or explaining why a section of the site lost traffic.

topics.title: Keyword Research and Search Intent
topics.description: Intent classification, demand sizing, keyword difficulty, entity and semantic coverage, keyword mapping.
topics.whenToUse: Use when planning new pages, classifying intent, sizing demand, clustering keywords by SERP overlap, or mapping queries to URLs.

topics.title: Link Building and Off-Page Authority
topics.description: Earning links, digital PR, anchor text and link quality, disavow decisions, and link spam policy.
topics.whenToUse: Use when planning link acquisition, evaluating a backlink profile, cleaning a toxic profile, or responding to a link-related manual action.

topics.title: Local SEO and Google Business Profile
topics.description: Local pack visibility, Business Profile optimization, reviews, citations and location page structure.
topics.whenToUse: Use when a business needs local pack visibility, when reviews or categories are wrong, or when planning location and service-area pages.

topics.title: International and Multilingual SEO
topics.description: Hreflang implementation, locale targeting, ccTLD vs subfolder decisions and localization quality.
topics.whenToUse: Use when serving multiple languages or regions, auditing hreflang return tags, or deciding URL structure for new markets.

topics.title: Ecommerce SEO and Faceted Navigation
topics.description: Category and product page optimization, faceted navigation, variants, out-of-stock handling and merchant feeds.
topics.whenToUse: Use when category pages cannibalize each other, when facets create crawl explosions, or when product and variant pages need indexing rules.

topics.title: SEO Analytics, Reporting and Measurement
topics.description: Search Console and GA4 measurement, rank tracking, dashboards, forecasting and KPI definitions.
topics.whenToUse: Use when building reports, explaining traffic changes, defining SEO KPIs, or instrumenting tracking for organic performance.

topics.title: AI Search, GEO and Answer Engines
topics.description: AI Overviews, AI Mode, LLM citation visibility, generative engine optimization and llms.txt conventions.
topics.whenToUse: Use when organic traffic is absorbed by AI answers, when planning visibility in AI Overviews or chat assistants, or when deciding on llms.txt and AI crawler access.

topics.title: Algorithm Updates, Spam Policy and Recovery
topics.description: Core and spam updates, ranking volatility, manual actions, policy changes and recovery playbooks.
topics.whenToUse: Use when rankings shift sharply, when a manual action or policy issue appears, or when assessing whether a site is exposed to a new spam policy.

topics.title: SERP Features, Snippets and CTR
topics.description: Featured snippets, People Also Ask, sitelinks, rich SERP layouts and click-through optimization.
topics.whenToUse: Use when chasing or defending a featured snippet, diagnosing CTR drops at stable rankings, or planning for SERP layout changes.

topics.title: Migrations, Redirects and HTTPS
topics.description: Site and domain migrations, redirect mapping, URL changes, HTTPS moves and post-migration recovery.
topics.whenToUse: Use when moving domains, replatforming, changing URL patterns, or diagnosing traffic loss after a launch.
